posts.title: january 2026
posts.description: January usually feels like such a slog: vacation/the holidays coming to an end; the backlog of work you’ve left for the next year last year hitting you full force; the days trudging on in an endless haze of “when’s the next day off?“; add to that the pressure of new year’s resolutions and feeling of you needing to get your life together because it’s the first month of the year and 2026 should star
